environment.experiment: Uninstrumented complete lifecycle; stage experiment is a separate process
environment.dom: Vitest happy-dom, not browser paint/GPU/network latency
environment.setup: Real public default Browser Host, published default manifest and CSS exports, one compiled business extension. Host creation/activation and fixture compilation occur outside named lifecycle batches. CSS asset I/O is process-cached by public export path.

units: milliseconds per complete named operation batch; nearest-rank p95; CSS and declaration costs in UTF-8 bytes

boundaries.cold: Successful Host composition.update adding tenant Seeds to an activated business scope
boundaries.warm100: 100 equivalent fresh composition requests, all successful noops
boundaries.coldB: First visit to a second concrete axis selection
boundaries.roundTrips20: 20 A→B→A round trips after warming both selections
boundaries.lru17: 17 sequential distinct selection visits, exceeding the app-owned successful declaration cache capacity of 16
boundaries.evictedA: Revisit initial selection after its LRU eviction
boundaries.newPortal: Acquire an initiating-scope portal with actual composition styles
boundaries.migrateRoot: Migrate the active root while a portal lease remains live
boundaries.dispose: Release portal and await Host disposal, including app-owned caches/resources
